scope: Fresh research-only physical Android comparison of YOLOX-Nano and the current locally pinned YOLO-World artifact. This is not a production model selection, G-3 signature, legal clearance, component-quality pass, or mass-quality pass.

fixtures.ground_truth: Conservative visible-component labels only; these public photos have no tared mass records.
fixtures.latency_protocol: One warm-up inference, then one sequential inference per fixture. With five timings, p95 equals the maximum and is not a latency acceptance measurement.

artifact.vocabulary: COCO-80 only; no custom ingredient prompts

execution.input_contract: 416px BGR letterbox padded with 114; upstream YOLOX decoded output; confidence >= 0.10; class-agnostic NMS IoU 0.45

ingredient_benchmark.scope: Exact labels in the COCO food subset only

weight_benchmark.reason: YOLOX-Nano has no mass output and the fixtures have no scale ground truth.

candidates.decision: Faster and smaller deployment screen than the current YOLO-World artifact, but lower limited-vocabulary component F1. Reject as the current ingredient or grams runtime.

artifact.vocabulary: embedded COCO-80 only; no custom ingredient prompts

execution.input_contract: 640px RGB resize; confidence >= 0.10; class-aware NMS IoU 0.70

ingredient_benchmark.scope: Exact labels in the COCO food subset only

weight_benchmark.reason: YOLO-World v2 has no mass output and the fixtures have no scale ground truth.

candidates.decision: Higher limited-vocabulary component F1 than YOLOX-Nano in this screen, but substantially slower and larger. It remains unsuitable as an ingredient or grams claim.

comparability.reason: Each candidate used its upstream inference contract; forcing one preprocessing/postprocessing contract would invalidate at least one model.

overall_decision: Neither fresh detector result satisfies the required visible-ingredient contract or calibrated grams. YOLOX-Nano is a deployment benchmark result only. Legal approval of the exact checkpoint and its training-data provenance remains a separate gate.
